[SWS_CORE_03312] Replacement with StringView
⌈
A member function
shall be defined for BasicString that allows replacement of a subsequence of *this
with the contents of a StringView:
BasicString& replace(size_type pos1, size_type n1, StringView sv);
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding std::basic_string func-
tion from [6, the C++17 standard].
⌋
